violations.description: Committed Docker configuration with auth token (.docker/.dockercfg)
violations.recommendation: Remove .docker/.dockercfg and .docker/config.json from the repository and do not commit authentication configuration.

violations.description: Committed Docker config JSON with auth token (.docker/config.json)

violations.evidence: Git credentials file containing username and password in .git-credentials
violations.recommendation: Remove .git-credentials and git-credentials files from version control.

violations.description: Committed netrc file with email and password (.netrc)
violations.evidence: Netrc file containing email and password for mail servers in .netrc

violations.description: Committed npmrc file with npm auth tokens (.npmrc)
violations.recommendation: Remove credentials from .npmrc and use environment variables or local user config outside the repo.

violations.evidence: Private SSH key stored in repository at .ssh/id_rsa
violations.recommendation: Revoke and remove the private key from the repository history, and add .ssh/ to .gitignore.

violations.evidence: AWS access key ID and secret access key stored in cloud/.credentials
violations.recommendation: Remove cloud/.credentials and use IAM roles or secure environment variables.

violations.description: Committed AWS S3 configuration with secret key (cloud/.s3cfg)
violations.recommendation: Remove .s3cfg or move secrets out of version control into environment variables or secret managers.

violations.evidence: System shadow file containing password hashes stored in etc/shadow
violations.recommendation: Remove etc/shadow immediately from version control.

violations.evidence: Private certificate key stored in misc-keys/cert-key.pem
violations.recommendation: Revoke and remove the private certificate key from the repository.

violations.evidence: PuTTY private key file stored in misc-keys/putty-example.ppk
violations.recommendation: Remove private key files from the repository.

violations.evidence: Ruby credentials master key stored in web/ruby/config/master.key
violations.recommendation: Remove master.key from the repository and use secure environment/secret injection.

violations.description: Committed Ruby secrets configuration with secret keys (web/ruby/secrets.yml)
violations.evidence: secret_key_base values stored in development, test, and production environments in web/ruby/secrets.yml
violations.recommendation: Remove secrets.yml from version control and use environment variables.

violations.description: Committed environment file (.env) with database and app secrets (web/var/www/.env)
violations.evidence: APP_KEY, DB_PASSWORD, and REDIS_PASSWORD stored in web/var/www/.env
violations.recommendation: Remove .env from version control and use .env.example templates.
